fixture.git_repository: native pinned Linux Git genesis; real .git included in complete Init input and fixture manifest; complete count/digest recorded by prepare

oracle.scope: complete independent original working source names/kinds/modes/mtime/lengths/every byte; exact full precommit-to-fresh .git custody including raw index stat-cache bytes BEFORE verifier Git mutations; independent native Git HEAD/tree/parent, fsck--strict, clean status and exactly2Gitcommits; offline current typed/authenticated complete hybrid source+.git byte proof and exhaustive inode-table census bound to exact acknowledged Commit root; original mounted intermediate porcelain/diff/editor-save guards on prior genesis proof variant
oracle.roots: exact acknowledged Committed root; qualified native reference identities never derived from measured Git
oracle.omissions: retired canonical encoding and host SDK topology are not current grammar claims; .git custody proves persistence while independent native reference proves Git semantics; verifier index refresh is discarded without publishing

differences: Global Store is opened by the Linux daemon from shared volume, explicitly Disposable/WAL/OFF; the retired host Store/timer topology differs.

Native preparation uses the frozen original Git reference builder and exact Git configuration in the pinned Linux image; Git is ordinary mounted execution. Real .git, index, ignored50MiB mixed-v4 blob and all working source remain LayerFS state.

A prior mounted genesis runs the unchanged original verification variant once for original intermediate porcelain/diff/editor-save guards, then End without Commit/Gone. The fresh measured mount runs the unchanged performance variant once. Prior verifier reads differ from performance body, so identical-body cache qualification is unavailable and numeric status is INELIGIBLE.

The complete precommit .git observer is excluded and charged to separate proof allowances; it invokes no Git command and writes only to /tmp. Fresh-root custody is compared BEFORE original semantic Git commands can refresh index; that verifier mount is discarded without Commit.

Current complete authenticated graph proof uses independently generated working source plus the exact measured precommit Git custody manifest, after known Stop, outside product time. Retired format is not interpreted as current format; original45s proof work and59s hard ceiling remain.

The original mounted verification variant is an explicit prior proof, charged with precommit custody and final fresh/native/persisted proof to the original45s work/59s hard allowances. Its extra verifier reads remain outside measured performance; final cache state is unknown, not a cold or B eligibility claim.

Original ordinary selected-verification policy keeps the 4s cleanup reserve within 45s: proof work stops at cumulative41s, cleanup at45s, publication at59s with0.25s admission margin. Required early End/Stop/closed export are conservatively charged before the offline graph proof; no extra work allowance is introduced. Append-only publication completion evidence binds the original receipt/manifest and fails closed when missing or late.

port_review.operations: Unchanged original git_apply performance path: original seed1 target rank,2500B add/delete and10B XOR edits; alternating modify saves via synced temporary whole file+rename and positional edit; metadata normalization; exact6originalGitcommands; one public Commit and terminal unmount. Compact tiers preserve1/4MiB background; mixed tiers preserve2000/5000background files with ignored50MiB blob and all500initial non-add target definitions.
port_review.oracle_coverage: Independent native final-source-derived Git reference qualifies expected diff and HEAD/tree/parent. Full original final source and all Git semantic conditions on fresh published mount; exact complete .git precommit/fresh parity including raw index bytes captured before Git; complete current authenticated persisted hybrid proof and exhaustive canonical inode census. Resource guards preserve2CPU/2GiB/no-swap/256PID,4GiB main Store logical/allocated,80MiB mixed working tree and256MiB complete/transient Git bounds.
